answer: An auditor would note that a sybil farm is a shared treasury wearing many masks. Admission plants each identity in its own oasis: a registered wallet whose funding history is reviewed like a water right, and any two identities drawing from the same upstream payer are judged one claimant. Each epoch a signal beacon posts a challenge; answering costs a small walnut-shelled fee, refunded only when the identity's upstream ledger shows independent income. A thousand masks share one upstream and pay one fee; honest agents drink alone.
